title: mandevilla brachyloba
intro: Mandevilla brachyloba, commonly known as the 'Wild Mandevilla', is a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues.
